```{r}
generate_heatmap <- function(data_matrix, annotation_df, 
                            groups = c("control", "stress"),
                            group_colors = c("control" = "#4D4D4D", "stress" = "#FE8A13"),
                            main = "Female Stress (LI)") {
  
  # Debug information
  cat("Debug Info:\n")
  cat("Specified groups:", paste(groups, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("Groups in metadata:", paste(unique(annotation_df$group), collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("Group colors:", paste(names(group_colors), collapse = ", "), "\n")
  
  # Clean the data matrix
  clean_data <- data_matrix[complete.cases(data_matrix) &
                              !apply(data_matrix, 1, function(x) any(is.infinite(x))), ]
  
  if (nrow(clean_data) < 2) {
    stop("Not enough valid data points after removing NA/NaN/Inf values")
  }

  scaled_data <- t(scale(t(clean_data)))
  scaled_data <- scaled_data[complete.cases(scaled_data), ]
  
  # Clean and filter annotation data
  annotation_df <- annotation_df %>%
    mutate(
      group = tolower(trimws(group))  # Clean the group names
    )
  
  cat("Groups after cleaning:", paste(unique(annotation_df$group), collapse = ", "), "\n")
  
  annotation_df <- annotation_df %>%
    filter(sample_id %in% colnames(scaled_data)) %>%
    arrange(factor(group, levels = groups))
  
  # Check what samples made it through filtering
  cat("Samples after filtering:", nrow(annotation_df), "\n")
  cat("Sample groups in final data:", paste(unique(annotation_df$group), collapse = ", "), "\n")
  
  sample_order <- annotation_df$sample_id
  scaled_data <- scaled_data[, sample_order, drop = FALSE]
  
  # Build annotation_col
  annotation_col <- data.frame(Group = factor(annotation_df$group, levels = groups))
  rownames(annotation_col) <- annotation_df$sample_id
  
  cat("Final annotation column:\n")
  print(table(annotation_col$Group))
  
  tryCatch({
    pheatmap(
      scaled_data,
      color = viridis(100),
      annotation_col = annotation_col,
      annotation_colors = list(Group = group_colors),
      cluster_cols = FALSE,
      cluster_rows = TRUE,
      clustering_method = "ward.D2",
      show_rownames = nrow(scaled_data) <= 150,
      show_colnames = ncol(scaled_data) <= 30,
      fontsize_row = 6,
      fontsize_col = 8,
      border_color = NA,
      treeheight_row = 100,
      treeheight_col = 50,
      main = main
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Heatmap error: ", e$message)
  })
}
```

## imputation methods
```{r}
prolix_msgfp <- function(data_matrix, groups, title = "Volcano Plot",
                         imp_meth = "none",
                         output_file = "volcano_results.tsv",
                         output_normalized = "normalized_values.tsv",
                         output_imputed = "imputed_values.tsv", 
                         normalize_method = "none",
                         plot_dir = "plots",
                         protein_info = NULL) {  
  
  groups <- factor(groups)
  if (length(levels(groups)) != 2) {
    stop("groups must have exactly two levels")
  }
  
  if (!dir.exists(plot_dir)) {
    dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }
  
  # Annotation columns to include in normalized and imputed exports
  export_annotation_cols <- c(
    "Cluster",
    "Gene",
    "Function",
    "Peptide Number",
    "Unique Peptide(s)",
    "Shared Peptide(s)",
    "Peptides",
    "Flanked Peptides"
  )

  # Helper function used to format both normalized and imputed exports
  format_abundance_export <- function(abundance_matrix, protein_info = NULL) {

    # Convert the abundance matrix to a data frame without changing column names
    export_df <- as.data.frame(
      abundance_matrix,
      check.names = FALSE
    )

    # Add protein identifiers from the matrix row names
    export_df$Protein <- rownames(abundance_matrix)

    # Preserve sample columns in their original order
    sample_cols <- colnames(abundance_matrix)
    available_annotation_cols <- character(0)

    if (!is.null(protein_info)) {

      if (!"Protein" %in% colnames(protein_info)) {
        stop("protein_info must contain a 'Protein' column")
      }

      if (anyDuplicated(protein_info$Protein) > 0) {
        warning(
          "protein_info contains duplicated Protein IDs. ",
          "Only the first matching annotation row will be used."
        )
      }

      # Match annotations to the protein order in the abundance matrix
      idx <- match(export_df$Protein, protein_info$Protein)

      # Keep annotation columns that are present in protein_info
      available_annotation_cols <- export_annotation_cols[
        export_annotation_cols %in% colnames(protein_info)
      ]

      # Report annotation columns that are missing
      missing_annotation_cols <- setdiff(
        export_annotation_cols,
        colnames(protein_info)
      )

      if (length(missing_annotation_cols) > 0) {
        warning(
          "The following requested annotation columns were not found in ",
          "protein_info and will not be included: ",
          paste(missing_annotation_cols, collapse = ", ")
        )
      }

      # Add annotations
      for (annotation_col in available_annotation_cols) {
        export_df[[annotation_col]] <- protein_info[[annotation_col]][idx]
      }

    } else {
      warning(
        "protein_info was not provided. ",
        "Only Protein and sample abundance columns will be exported."
      )
    }

    # Final order: Protein, samples, then annotation columns
    final_cols <- c(
      "Protein",
      sample_cols,
      available_annotation_cols
    )

    export_df <- export_df[, final_cols, drop = FALSE]

    return(export_df)
  }
  
  cat("\n=== Pre-processing ===\n")
  cat("Original dimensions:", nrow(data_matrix), "proteins x", ncol(data_matrix), "samples\n")
  
  # Store original row names before any processing
  protein_names <- rownames(data_matrix)
  
  # Log2 transform
  data_matrix[data_matrix == 0] <- data_matrix[data_matrix == 0] + 1
  # Apply the log2 transformation
  data_matrix <- log2(data_matrix)
  cat("NAs after log2:", sum(is.na(data_matrix)), "\n")
  cat("Inf after log2:", sum(is.infinite(data_matrix)), "\n")
  
  # Convert 0 to NA
  data_matrix[data_matrix == 0] <- NA
  cat("Missing values:", sum(is.na(data_matrix)), 
      "(", round(100 * sum(is.na(data_matrix))/length(data_matrix), 1), "%)\n")
  
  # Normalization
  if (normalize_method == "quantile") {
    cat("Applying quantile normalization...\n")
    n_df_final <- normalizeBetweenArrays(data_matrix, method = "quantile")
  } else if (normalize_method == "median") {
    cat("Applying median normalization...\n")
    n_df_final <- normalizeBetweenArrays(data_matrix, method = "scale")
  } else if (normalize_method == "cyclicloess") {
    cat("Applying cyclicloess normalization...\n")
    n_df_final <- normalizeBetweenArrays(data_matrix, method = "cyclicloess")
  } else {
    cat("No normalization applied.\n")
    n_df_final <- data_matrix
  }
  
  cat("Final check - NAs:", sum(is.na(n_df_final)),
      "NaNs:", sum(is.nan(n_df_final)),
      "Inf:", sum(is.infinite(n_df_final)), "\n")
  
  rownames(n_df_final) <- protein_names
  colnames(n_df_final) <- colnames(data_matrix)
  
  # Normalization plots
  pdf(file.path(plot_dir, "normalization_boxplot.pdf"), width = 12, height = 6)
  par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(8, 4, 3, 2))
  group_colors <- ifelse(groups == levels(groups)[1], "lightblue", "lightcoral")
  boxplot(data_matrix, main = "Before Normalization", las = 2,
          col = group_colors, cex.axis = 0.7, ylab = "Log2 Intensity")
  legend("topright", legend = levels(groups), fill = c("lightblue", "lightcoral"), cex = 0.8)
  boxplot(n_df_final, main = paste("After", normalize_method), las = 2,
          col = group_colors, cex.axis = 0.7, ylab = "Log2 Intensity")
  dev.off()
  
  pdf(file.path(plot_dir, "normalization_density.pdf"), width = 12, height = 6)
  par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
  plot(density(data_matrix[, 1], na.rm = TRUE), main = "Before Normalization",
       xlim = range(data_matrix, na.rm = TRUE), col = 1, lwd = 2,
       xlab = "Log2 Intensity", ylab = "Density")
  for (i in 2:ncol(data_matrix)) {
    lines(density(data_matrix[, i], na.rm = TRUE), col = i, lwd = 2)
  }
  plot(density(n_df_final[, 1], na.rm = TRUE), main = paste("After", normalize_method),
       xlim = range(n_df_final, na.rm = TRUE), col = 1, lwd = 2,
       xlab = "Log2 Intensity", ylab = "Density")
  for (i in 2:ncol(n_df_final)) {
    lines(density(n_df_final[, i], na.rm = TRUE), col = i, lwd = 2)
  }
  dev.off()

  # Export normalized non-imputed values
  cat("\n=== Exporting normalized non-imputed values ===\n")
  
  norm_df_export <- format_abundance_export(
    abundance_matrix = n_df_final,
    protein_info = protein_info
  )
  
  write.table(
    norm_df_export,
    file = output_normalized,
    sep = "\t",
    quote = FALSE,
    row.names = FALSE,
    na = ""
  )
  
  cat("Normalized values saved to:", output_normalized, "\n")
  cat(
    "Dimensions:",
    nrow(norm_df_export),
    "proteins x",
    ncol(norm_df_export),
    "columns\n"
  )
  
  cat(
    "Column order:\n",
    paste(colnames(norm_df_export), collapse = " | "),
    "\n"
  )
    
   # Imputation
  set.seed(123)
  if (imp_meth == "MinDet") {
    cat("Applying MinDet imputation....\n")
    imp_df <- impute.MinDet(as.matrix(n_df_final), q = 0.01)
  } else if (imp_meth == "MinProb") {
    cat("Applying MinProb imputation....\n")
    imp_df <- impute.MinProb(as.matrix(n_df_final), q = 0.01)
  } else if (imp_meth == "QRILC") {
    cat("Applying QRILC imputation....\n")
    imp_df <- impute.QRILC(as.matrix(n_df_final), tune.sigma = 1)
  } else if (imp_meth == "KNN") {
    cat("Applying KNN imputation....\n")
    imp_df <- impute.wrapper.KNN(as.matrix(n_df_final), K = 5)
  } else if (imp_meth == "Hybrid") {
    cat("Applying Hybrid (Filtered) Imputation...\n")

  mat <- as.matrix(n_df_final)

  groups_factor <- factor(groups)
  levs <- levels(groups_factor)

  g1_idx <- which(groups_factor == levs[1])
  g2_idx <- which(groups_factor == levs[2])

  g1_mat <- mat[, g1_idx, drop = FALSE]
  g2_mat <- mat[, g2_idx, drop = FALSE]

  ### ---------- GROUP IMPUTATION FUNCTION ---------- ###

impute_group <- function(group_mat) {

  # Count true detections
  present_counts <- rowSums(!is.na(group_mat) & group_mat > 0)

  MAR_rows  <- present_counts >= 3
  MNAR_rows <- present_counts > 0 & present_counts < 3
  ZERO_rows <- present_counts == 0

  cat("MAR rows:", sum(MAR_rows), "\n")
  cat("MNAR rows:", sum(MNAR_rows), "\n")
  cat("Zero rows:", sum(ZERO_rows), "\n")

  result <- group_mat

  # ---------- MAR → KNN ----------
  if (sum(MAR_rows) > 0) {

    mar_mat <- group_mat[MAR_rows, , drop = FALSE]

    mar_imp <- impute.wrapper.KNN(
      as.matrix(mar_mat),
      K = 5
    )

    result[MAR_rows, ] <- mar_imp
  }

  # ---------- MNAR → MinProb ----------
  if (sum(MNAR_rows) > 0) {

  # Run MinProb on the entire group matrix
  full_minprob <- impute.MinProb(
    as.matrix(group_mat),
    q = 0.01
  )

  # Only copy imputed MNAR rows
  result[MNAR_rows, ] <- full_minprob[MNAR_rows, ]
  }

  # ---------- Structural absence ----------
  if (sum(ZERO_rows) > 0) {

    col_mins <- apply(group_mat, 2, function(x) {
      if(all(is.na(x))) return(-20)
      min(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    })

    low_vals <- col_mins - 1

    for (i in which(ZERO_rows)) {
      result[i, ] <- low_vals
    }
  }

  return(result)
}

  ### ---------- APPLY TO EACH GROUP ---------- ###

  cat("\nProcessing group:", levs[1], "\n")
  g1_imp <- impute_group(g1_mat)

  cat("\nProcessing group:", levs[2], "\n")
  g2_imp <- impute_group(g2_mat)

  ### ---------- RECOMBINE ---------- ###

  imp_df <- cbind(g1_imp, g2_imp)

  imp_df <- imp_df[, colnames(mat)]  

} else if (imp_meth == "zero") {
  cat("Applying Zero imputation (NA -> 0)...\n")
  imp_df <- as.matrix(n_df_final)
  imp_df[is.na(imp_df)] <- 0
} else {
  cat("Not Applying Imputation....\n")
  imp_df <- as.matrix(n_df_final)
}

  # Export imputed values
  cat("\n=== Exporting imputed values ===\n")
  
  # Make sure imputed matrix retains protein and sample names
  rownames(imp_df) <- rownames(n_df_final)
  colnames(imp_df) <- colnames(n_df_final)
  
  imp_df_export <- format_abundance_export(
    abundance_matrix = imp_df,
    protein_info = protein_info
  )
  
  write.table(
    imp_df_export,
    file = output_imputed,
    sep = "\t",
    quote = FALSE,
    row.names = FALSE,
    na = ""
  )
  
  cat("Imputed values saved to:", output_imputed, "\n")
  cat(
    "Dimensions:",
    nrow(imp_df_export),
    "proteins x",
    ncol(imp_df_export),
    "columns\n"
  )
  
  cat(
    "Column order:\n",
    paste(colnames(imp_df_export), collapse = " | "),
    "\n"
  )
    
    # Diagnostic check
    cat("\nAfter", imp_meth, "imputation:\n")
    cat("  NAs:", sum(is.na(imp_df)), "\n")
    cat("  Zeros:", sum(imp_df == 0, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
    cat("  Negative:", sum(imp_df < 0, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
    cat("  Range:", paste(round(range(imp_df, na.rm = TRUE), 2), collapse = " to "), "\n")
  
  # Floor value check
  if(any(is.na(imp_df))) {
    n_na <- sum(is.na(imp_df))
    warning(paste(imp_meth, "left", n_na, "NAs - applying floor value"))
    min_obs <- min(imp_df, na.rm = TRUE)
    imp_df[is.na(imp_df)] <- min_obs
  }
  
  if(any(imp_df <= 0, na.rm = TRUE)) {
    n_zero <- sum(imp_df <= 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    warning(paste(imp_meth, "produced", n_zero, "zero/negative values - applying floor"))
    min_obs <- min(imp_df[imp_df > 0], na.rm = TRUE)
    imp_df[imp_df <= 0] <- min_obs
  }
  
  # Design matrix
  design <- model.matrix(~0 + groups)
  colnames(design) <- levels(groups)
  
  # Array weights check
  aw <- arrayWeights(imp_df, design)
  cat("\nArray weights summary:\n")
  print(summary(aw))
  cat("Range:", round(range(aw), 3), "\n")
  cat("SD:", round(sd(aw), 3), "\n")
  
  # Conditional fit based on weights variance
  if(sd(aw) / mean(aw) < 0.02) {
    cat("→ Weights are very similar - not using them in fit\n")
    fit <- lmFit(imp_df, design)
  } else {
    cat("→ Weights vary substantially - using them in fit\n")
    fit <- lmFit(imp_df, design, weights = aw)
  }
  
  # Weights plot
  pdf(file.path(plot_dir, "weights_plot.pdf"), width = 8, height = 6)
  barplot(aw,
          names.arg = colnames(imp_df),
          las = 2,
          main = paste("Array Weights per Sample (SD =", round(sd(aw), 3), ")"),
          ylab = "Weight",
          col = as.numeric(groups))
  legend("topright",
         legend = levels(groups),
         fill = seq_along(levels(groups)),
         title = "Groups")
  dev.off()
  
  # Contrasts
  contrast_str <- paste0(levels(groups)[2], " - ", levels(groups)[1])
  contrast_matrix <- makeContrasts(contrasts = contrast_str, levels = design)
  
  fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, contrast_matrix)
  fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)
  
  # Mean-variance plot
  pdf(file.path(plot_dir, "mean_variance_trend.pdf"), width = 8, height = 6)
  plotSA(fit2, main = "Mean-variance relationship")
  dev.off()
  
  # Extract results
  results <- topTable(fit2, number = Inf, sort.by = "none", adjust.method = "BH") %>%
    rownames_to_column("Protein") %>%
    mutate(
      log10p = -log10(P.Value),
      regulation = case_when(
        adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC > 2.0  ~ "Up",
        adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC < -2.0 ~ "Down",
        TRUE ~ "NS"
      )
    )
  
  cat("\n=== SUMMARY ===\n")
  cat("Imputation method:", imp_meth, "\n")
  cat("Normalization method:", normalize_method, "\n")
  cat("Total proteins:", nrow(results), "\n")
  cat("Up-regulated:", sum(results$regulation == "Up"), "\n")
  cat("Down-regulated:", sum(results$regulation == "Down"), "\n")
  cat("Not significant:", sum(results$regulation == "NS"), "\n")
  
  # Get top features
  top_features <- results %>%
    filter(regulation %in% c("Up", "Down")) %>%
    arrange(adj.P.Val) %>%
    head(10)

  # Volcano plot
  p_volcano <- ggplot(results, aes(x = logFC, y = log10p, color = regulation)) +
  # Shading in plot    
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = 2, xmax = Inf,
    ymin = 1.3, ymax = Inf,
    fill = "#E69F00", alpha = 0.12
  ) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = -Inf, xmax = -2,
    ymin = 1.3, ymax = Inf,
    fill = "#4D4D4D", alpha = 0.12
  ) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 3) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-2.0, 2.0), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("Down" = "#4D4D4D", "Up" = "#E69F00", "NS" = "grey"),
    ) +
    labs(x = "Log2 Fold Change", y = "-Log10 p-value", title = title) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "right",
          legend.title = element_blank()
    )
  
  ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "volcano_plot.pdf"), p_volcano, width = 10, height = 8)

  # MA plot
  p_ma <- ggplot(results, aes(x = AveExpr, y = logFC, color = regulation)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = c(-2.0, 2.0), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey30") +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("Down" = "#4D4D4D", "Up" = "#E69F00", "NS" = "grey"),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    labs(x = "Average Expression (log2)", y = "Log2 Fold Change", 
         title = paste(title, "- MA Plot")) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "right")

  ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "ma_plot.pdf"), p_ma, width = 10, height = 8)

  # P-value histogram
  p_hist <- ggplot(results, aes(x = P.Value)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "steelblue", color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0.05, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 1) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = Inf, vjust = 2,
             label = paste("Significant (p<0.05):", sum(results$P.Value < 0.05)), 
             color = "red", size = 4) +
    labs(x = "P-value", y = "Frequency", title = "P-value Distribution") +
    theme_minimal()
  
  ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "pvalue_histogram.pdf"), p_hist, width = 8, height = 6)
  
  # Top proteins heatmap
  top_proteins <- results %>%
    filter(regulation %in% c("Up", "Down")) %>%
    arrange(adj.P.Val) %>%
    head(min(100, sum(results$regulation %in% c("Up", "Down")))) %>%
    pull(Protein)
  
  if (length(top_proteins) > 1) {
    heatmap_data <- imp_df[top_proteins, , drop = FALSE]
    
    annotation_col <- data.frame(
      Group = groups,
      row.names = colnames(heatmap_data)
    )
    
    ann_colors <- list(Group = c("#4D4D4D", "#E69F00"))
    names(ann_colors$Group) <- levels(groups)
    
    pdf(file.path(plot_dir, "top_proteins_heatmap.pdf"), width = 10, height = 12)
    pheatmap(heatmap_data,
             scale = "row",
             clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
             clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean",
             clustering_method = "ward.D2",
             annotation_col = annotation_col,
             annotation_colors = ann_colors,
             show_rownames = TRUE,
             show_colnames = TRUE,
             fontsize_row = 8,
             main = paste("Top", length(top_proteins), "Differentially Expressed Proteins"))
    dev.off()
  }
  # PCA plot -
  # Temporary imputation for visualization only
  log_data_pca <- imp_df

  # Replace NAs or Infs with row medians (simple conservative approach)
  for (i in 1:nrow(log_data_pca)) {
    row_vals <- log_data_pca[i, ]
    med <- median(row_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (is.na(med) || is.infinite(med)) med <- 0
    log_data_pca[i, is.na(row_vals) | is.infinite(row_vals)] <- med
  }

  # Now PCA
  pca_result <- prcomp(t(log_data_pca), scale. = FALSE)
  pca_df <- data.frame(
    pca_result$x, 
    Group = as.character(groups),
    Sample = colnames(n_df_final),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  variance_explained <- summary(pca_result)$importance[2, ] * 100
  
  pcs <- pca_result$x[, 1:5]
  permanova_res <- adonis2(pcs ~ groups, method = "euclidean")

  # Convert variance to a numeric vector
  var_exp <- variance_explained
  
  # Extract protein loadings
  loadings <- as.data.frame(pca_result$rotation)

  loadings$Protein <- rownames(loadings)

  # Add absolute contribution for ranking
  loadings <- loadings %>%
    mutate(
      PC1_contribution = abs(PC1),
      PC2_contribution = abs(PC2)
    )

  top_pc1 <- loadings %>%
    arrange(desc(PC1_contribution))

  top_pc2 <- loadings %>%
    arrange(desc(PC2_contribution))

  pc1_annotated <- top_pc1 %>%
  left_join(protein_info %>% select(Protein, Gene, Function), by="Protein")

  pc1_annotated <- pc1_annotated %>%
  mutate(direction =
    ifelse(PC1 > 0, "Positive_PC1", "Negative_PC1")
  )
  
  write_tsv(pc1_annotated, "pca_pc1_drivers.tsv")

  pc2_annotated <- top_pc2 %>%
  left_join(protein_info %>% select(Protein, Gene, Function), by="Protein")

  pc2_annotated <- pc2_annotated %>%
  mutate(direction =
    ifelse(PC1 > 0, "Positive_PC1", "Negative_PC1")
  )
  
  write_tsv(pc2_annotated, "pca_pc2_drivers.tsv")
  
  # Compute weighted contribution
  pcs_to_use <- paste0("PC",1:5)

weighted_scores <- loadings %>%
  mutate(
    weighted_contribution =
      abs(PC1)*var_exp[1] +
      abs(PC2)*var_exp[2] +
      abs(PC3)*var_exp[3] +
      abs(PC4)*var_exp[4] +
      abs(PC5)*var_exp[5]
  )

# Rank drivers
top_drivers <- weighted_scores %>%
  arrange(desc(weighted_contribution))

# Add protein, direction, and save
top_drivers <- top_drivers %>%
  left_join(protein_info %>% select(Protein, Gene, Function), by="Protein")

top_drivers <- top_drivers %>%
  mutate(direction =
    ifelse(PC1 > 0, "Positive_PC1", "Negative_PC1")
  ) %>%
  left_join(results, by="Protein")

write_tsv(top_drivers, "pca_weighted_drivers.tsv")
  
# Extract p-value
p_val <- permanova_res$`Pr(>F)`[1]

# Define consistent group colors
group_colors <- c()
group_colors[levels(groups)[1]] <- "#4D4D4D"  # Control
group_colors[levels(groups)[2]] <- "#E69F00"  # Stress

pp_pca <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Group)) +

  # Ellipse shading
  stat_ellipse(
    aes(fill = Group),
    geom = "polygon",
    level = 0.95,
    alpha = 0.15,
    color = NA
  ) +

  # Sample points
  geom_point(
    size = 4.5,
    stroke = 1.2
  ) +

  # Sample labels
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = Sample),
    size = 4,
    box.padding = 0.5,
    segment.color = "grey50"
  ) +

  # Add p-value annotation
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = Inf,
    y = Inf,
    label = paste0("PERMANOVA p = ", signif(p_val, 3)),
    hjust = 1.1,
    vjust = 1.5,
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +

  # Colors
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +

  labs(
    title = "Female Large Intestine PCA Plot - Sample Clustering",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(variance_explained[1], 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(variance_explained[2], 1), "%)")
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.8),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 18),
    panel.border = element_rect(
      color = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 1
    )
  )

ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "pca_plot.pdf"), pp_pca, width = 10, height = 8)
  
  # Save results table
  results_filtered <- results %>% filter(regulation %in% c("Up", "Down"))
  write.table(results_filtered, output_file, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
  
  cat("\n=== All plots saved to:", plot_dir, "===\n")
  cat("Results table saved to:", output_file, "\n")
  cat("Imputed values saved to:", output_imputed, "\n")
  
  return(list(
    volcano_plot = p_volcano,
    ma_plot = p_ma,
    pca_plot = pp_pca,
    fit = fit2,
    results = results,
    normalized_data = n_df_final,
    normalized_non_imputed = norm_df_export,
    imputed_data = imp_df_export
  ))
}
```
